headline: 60 kmph winds: Low pressure in Bay of Bengal triggers heavy rain
summary: Stormy weather is expected in seven districts, with winds reaching up to 60 kmph by 9 AM.
details: A low-pressure system in the Bay of Bengal has triggered heavy rainfall across several districts of Bangladesh.
Weather forecasts indicate that seven districts are likely to experience squall winds reaching speeds of up to 60 kmph by 9 AM.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to take necessary precautions as the weather system continues to move across the region.
The low pressure is causing widespread instability in the atmosphere, leading to the predicted heavy rains and strong winds.

headline_marked: DB raid in Aftabnagar: [[Robber shot and arrested]] with foreign pistol
headline: DB raid in Aftabnagar: Robber shot and arrested with foreign pistol
summary: A member of a robbery gang was shot and apprehended by the Detective Branch (DB) during an operation in Dhaka's Aftabnagar area.
details: A member of a robbery gang was shot and arrested during a Detective Branch (DB) operation in the Aftabnagar area of Dhaka.
The suspect was apprehended after a gunfight broke out between the DB police and the gang members during the raid.
Police recovered a foreign-made pistol and ammunition from the suspect's possession.
The operation was part of a larger effort to crack down on robbery gangs operating in the capital city.
